sections.heading: Overview of Alumni Association
sections.content:
MR.SANDIP K. RAJPUT President(Alumni), Alumni Association of APCOER 7588537910 rajputsandipme@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/sandip-rajput-b192b838
I am proud and honored to introduce myself as the current president of the Alumni Association. I have been a part of the Association since May 2018, when one of my professor suggested me because he thought I would be a good fit. I post graduated from the SPPU in Design Engineering (Mechanical). I believe I was one of the first members from institute to be on the Alumni Association committee. I am excited to welcome the incoming class of students, as well as those returning to campus. The Alumni Association is committed to contributing to student success. We are doing more to connect with students, our future alumni, including having a presence at commencement,New student orientation, the Student Fair, speaking to individual classes and more
